title: How many faces, edges and vertices has a ten sided pyramid?
description: A pyramid has a base with ten sides. The video counts its faces, edges and vertices and then writes the counts for a base with n sides. Keeko's doubt is that the pyramid has ten edges.
teaching_notes: One idea: a pyramid on an n sided base has n plus one faces, two n edges and n plus one vertices. Watch for students who count only the edges of the base, or only the edges that rise to the top.

source: A pyramid has a 10 sided base. Find its faces, edges and ver
video_script.why: The child has counted the parts of a prism and now counts them for a pyramid on a base with ten sides, then with n sides.
video_script.substitution: Count the faces, edges and vertices from the base and the top, then write the same counts for n sides.
video_script.anchor: a pyramid standing on a base with ten sides, with a top corner above the base
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko counts only the ten edges of the base and says the pyramid has ten edges. Ten more edges rise from the corners of the base to the top, so the pyramid has twenty edges.
video_script.payoff_line: The pyramid has eleven faces, twenty edges and eleven vertices

final_answer.value: 11 faces, 20 edges, 11 vertices; for n sides, n + 1 faces, 2n edges and n + 1 vertices
final_answer.spoken: eleven faces, twenty edges and eleven vertices; for n sides, n plus one faces, two n edges and n plus one vertices

hold_back: Answer: 11 faces, 20 edges, 11 vertices; for n sides, n + 1 faces, 2n edges and n + 1 vertices
maths_rules: edges: 10 on the base and 10 rising to the top, 10 + 10 = 20
vertices: 10 on the base and 1 at the top, 10 + 1 = 11
for n sides: n + 1 faces, 2n edges, n + 1 vertices
slip: counting only the edges of the base gives 10 edges
video_script.design: A pyramid on a ten sided base stands on the stage; faces, edges and vertices glow in turn with the count beside each, and then the counts are rewritten with n.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; a pyramid standing on a base with ten sides; labels faces, edges and vertices each with a question mark

marks.book: the title card and the pyramid appear
marks.ask: the three labels appear with question marks
marks.more: the number 10 on the base changes to n

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about pyramids.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>The base of a pyramid has ten sides. How many faces, edges and vertices does the pyramid have?
<bookmark mark='more'/>What if the base has n sides?

beats.on_screen: the pyramid and the three labels stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: a polygon base; a top corner above it; edges drawn from the top corner to each corner of the base; the side faces shaded as triangles

marks.base: the polygon base appears with a top corner above it
marks.join: edges are drawn from the top corner to each corner of the base
marks.side: the side faces are shaded as triangles

narration: <bookmark mark='base'/>A pyramid has a base with straight sides, and a corner above it.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Edges connect that top corner with each corner of the base.
<bookmark mark='side'/>The faces on the sides are triangles, one for each side of the base.

beats.on_screen: Given: pyramid with a base of 10 sides

marks.given: the base is labelled 10 sides on the pyramid

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, a pyramid has a base with ten sides.

beats.on_screen: To find: faces, edges, vertices, for 10 sides and for n sides

marks.find: the words faces, edges and vertices are written with 10 sides and n sides

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the faces, edges and vertices, first for ten sides and then for n sides.
<bookmark mark='tri'/>Step one, count the faces. Each of the ten sides of the base gives one triangle, so there are ten of them.
<bookmark mark='base'/>The base is one more face.
<bookmark mark='calc'/>Ten plus one is eleven faces.

beats.on_screen: Edges: 10 on the base and 10 rising to the top: 10 + 10 = 20

marks.base: the ten edges of the base glow
marks.rise: the ten edges rising to the top glow and 10 + 10 = 20 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='base'/>Step two, count the edges. The base has ten edges.
<bookmark mark='rise'/>Ten more edges rise from the corners of the base to the top. Ten plus ten is twenty edges.

beats.on_screen: Vertices: 10 on the base and 1 at the top, 10 + 1 = 11

marks.corners: the ten corners of the base and the top corner are marked with dots

narration: <bookmark mark='corners'/>Step three, count the vertices. The base has ten corners, and the top has one more.
<bookmark mark='calc'/>Ten plus one is eleven vertices.

beats.on_screen: For n sides: faces n + 1, edges 2n, vertices n + 1. Put n = 10: 11, 20, 11.

marks.rule: n + 1, 2n and n + 1 are written in place of the counts
marks.check: n = 10 is put in and 11, 20 and 11 are written and ticked

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Step four, do the same counting for n sides. The faces are n plus one, the edges are two n, and the vertices are n plus one.
<bookmark mark='check'/>Put n equal to ten, and the counts match the ones above.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 11 faces, 20 edges, 11 vertices; for n sides, n + 1 faces, 2n edges and n + 1 vertices

marks.gen: the counts for n sides are written under the box

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The pyramid has eleven faces, twenty edges and eleven vertices.
<bookmark mark='gen'/>For n sides, it has n plus one faces, two n edges and n plus one vertices.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the pyramid
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows 10 edges, struck through; the ten edges rising to the top glow on the pyramid

marks.doubt: the bubble with 10 edges appears beside the pyramid
marks.rise: the ten edges rising to the top glow on the pyramid
marks.fix: the bubble is struck through and 20 edges returns

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the pyramid has ten edges, because the base has ten edges.
<bookmark mark='rise'/>Look at the pyramid again. Ten more edges rise from the corners of the base to the top corner.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Those edges count too, so the pyramid has twenty edges.
